ref_text: IT WILL BE WELL FOR YOU IF YOU JOIN NOT WITH THOSE WHO INSTEAD OF KITES FLY FALCONS WHO INSTEAD OF OBEYING THE LAST WORDS OF THE GREAT CLOUD SHEPHERD TO FEED HIS SHEEP LIVE THE LIVES HOW MUCH LESS THAN VANITY OF THE WAR WOLF AND THE GIER EAGLE
text: It will be well for you if you join not with those who instead of kites fly falcons, who instead of obeying the last words of the great cloud-shepard to feed his sheep, live the lives. How much less than vanity of the war wolf and the gear eagle?
